title: council 0.13.0: ME-004, Anthropic jobs ask for caching and log what it did
head: build/ME-004-council-cache
body:
ME-004 from DESIGN.md (council 0.13.0, marketplace 1.165.0). **Stacked on #297 (SR-002)**: the base is that branch, and this retargets to `main` once #297 merges. It does not merge before then.

`openrouter_dispatch.py` adds top-level `cache_control` to `anthropic/` jobs unless the job sets `"cache": false`, and records `cache: {read, write, requested}` per job in each result and in `_summary.json`. A job that never asked for caching is reported as caching not requested.

**Live result** (`docs/evidence/ME-004-live.md`): in a real deliberation Claude wrote 13,450 tokens to the cache across stages 2 and 3 and read none; its 320-token stage 1 prompt was below the cache minimum. A cost with no saving, as the item predicted. Nothing is switched off: whether to set `"cache": false` in the deliberation engine's jobs is Dorian's call.

Also seen, not part of this item: at the documented 3,000-token cap the Claude slot returned empty content at stage 1.
